sloka: एवं सम्भर्त्स्यमाना सा सीता सुरसुतोपमा ।राक्षसीभिः सुघोराभिर्धैर्यमुत्सृज्य रोदिति ।। ५.२२.४२।।
transliteration: evaṁ sambhartsyamānā sā sītā surasutopamā ।rākṣasībhiḥ sughorābhirdhairyamutsṛjya roditi ।। 5.22.42।।

translations.english: The body of a man who desires a woman without desire is only tormented; but for one who desires a willing woman, the pleasure is delightful.
